topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: How could they? Every word, a piece of me, laid bare on paper, twisted into their tales. I thought we shared secrets, but this—this is different. They took what’s mine, the very essence of who I am, and repackaged it for strangers to consume. Now, everyone will think they know me, through their lens, their version. What right do they have to rewrite what’s between us? The world doesn’t need to see the shadows of my heart, the parts I chose to hide, to protect. This betrayal, it cuts deep, unraveling the trust we built.
